main.title: Atomic Heart
main.subtitle: A retrofuturistic utopia falls apart
main.summary: Atomic Heart is a 2023 first-person shooter video game developed by Mundfish Studio.

cards.heading: A retrofuturistic utopia falls apart
cards.text:
Atomic Heart is a 2023 first-person shooter video game developed by Mundfish Studio. It was published by VK Play, Focus Entertainment, and 4Divinity.  
The game is set in an alternate history version of the Soviet Union, during the 1950s. Initially depicted as a retrofuturistic utopia, the game follows the collapse of an advanced Soviet research city after a robot uprising.

cards.heading: Weapons, robots and scavenged materials
cards.text: Atomic Heart is a first-person shooter video game with role-playing elements. Weapons include conventional firearms, energy-based weapons, and melee weapons. A wide variety of enemies are featured, most of which are robots; mutants are another type of enemy consisting of human corpses animated by genetically-engineered plant-like organisms called sprouts. A crafting system allows the player to piece weapons together from metal parts that can be detached from robots or taken from household appliances.  Ammo in the game is scarce, so the player also has the option to use rechargeable energy guns. Quick-time events are featured in the game.

cards.heading: The powers of the Polymer Glove
cards.text: The player wears a special glove, the Polymer Glove, which grants powers such as telekinesis, freezing, shield, electricity and others to defeat foes. Its powers can be combined with both melee and ranged weapons.

main.title: Horizon Call of the Mountain
main.subtitle: Horizon seen from the next handhold
main.summary: Horizon Call of the Mountain is Guerrilla and Firesprite's virtual-reality adventure, released with PlayStation VR2 on 22 February 2023.

cards.heading: Horizon seen from the next handhold
cards.text: Horizon Call of the Mountain is Guerrilla and Firesprite's virtual-reality adventure, released with PlayStation VR2 on 22 February 2023. Ryas, a former Shadow Carja soldier seeking a pardon, investigates a disturbance among the machines. The first-person viewpoint brings the scale of Horizon's world close to the player, from a cliff directly above to a mechanical creature moving nearby. Climbing supplies much of the journey, making the next handhold and the height beneath it practical parts of moving through the landscape.

cards.heading: Climb with both hands
cards.text: The motion controllers let the player reach for grips, ropes and vines, supporting progress through physical gestures. Later tools include pickaxes and a grappling hook, extending the kinds of surface and gap that can be crossed. Different movement options accommodate how players prefer to navigate in virtual reality. The environment is read through reach and distance: a visible destination becomes a series of manageable holds, while looking away from the wall reveals the height gained during the ascent and the route still to travel.

cards.heading: A new viewpoint on the machines
cards.text: Ryas's investigation gives the climbs and encounters a place within the wider Horizon setting. The game was developed alongside Forbidden West but built in Unreal Engine 4, with VR2 features such as eye tracking and haptic feedback informing its presentation. Alistair Kerley and Frankie Harper composed the score. Its narrower, first-person journey offers another relationship with a familiar world: terrain becomes something the player grips and traverses, and the machines are encountered at the bodily scale suggested by standing beneath them.

main.title: Blood Bowl 3
main.subtitle: Fantasy football returns with new rules
main.summary: Blood Bowl 3 is a turn-based fantasy sports video game developed by Cyanide Studios and published by Nacon.

cards.heading: Fantasy football returns with new rules
cards.text: Blood Bowl 3 is a turn-based fantasy sports video game developed by Cyanide Studios and published by Nacon. It is a sequel to the 2015 video game Blood Bowl 2, based on the Blood Bowl board game by Games Workshop and is the third Blood Bowl game created by Cyanide. The game was released on 23 February 2023 for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S, with a Nintendo Switch port planned to be released at a later date.

cards.heading: A campaign and multiplayer matches
cards.text: The game uses the newly updated Second Season ruleset. It contains a single-player campaign as well as multiplayer.

cards.heading: Delays and a troubled launch
cards.text: The game was announced in August 2020 but had numerous delays and postponement to its release date. The launch was met with criticism over the new monetisation system introduced into the game, bugs and crashes, poor AI, readability, as well as server issues and a lack of tools and features present in the previous game.

main.title: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty
main.subtitle: Deflection at the Heart of a Demonic Three Kingdoms
main.summary: Team NINJA's Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty places a nameless militia soldier in a demonic version of Later Han China.

cards.heading: History enters dark fantasy
cards.text: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty is Team NINJA's 2023 action role-playing game set in a demonic version of Later Han China. The player controls a nameless militia soldier in a fantasy built around the era associated with the Three Kingdoms. Combat centres on deflection, while flags placed around each battlefield help establish a stronger position for repeated attempts.

cards.heading: Deflect to change the exchange
cards.text: Spirit rises through successful attacks and deflections and falls through damage and other costly actions. Reaching the lower limit leaves a fighter temporarily vulnerable. Defence can therefore become a way to gain the resources for an attack, making a well-timed response change more than the amount of health lost.

cards.heading: Flags mark a foothold
cards.text: Raising flags increases Fortitude, setting a floor beneath the Morale that can be lost on defeat. Battle Flags also provide recovery and a return point. Exploring a battlefield can make another attempt more manageable, so progress includes establishing a foothold as well as reaching the next opponent.

main.title: Bayonetta Origins: Cereza and the Lost Demon
main.subtitle: A young witch enters the forest
main.summary: Bayonetta Origins: Cereza and the Lost Demon is PlatinumGames' action adventure, released for Nintendo Switch on 17 March 2023.

cards.heading: A young witch enters the forest
cards.text: Bayonetta Origins: Cereza and the Lost Demon is PlatinumGames' action adventure, released for Nintendo Switch on 17 March 2023. It follows Bayonetta's younger self, Cereza, as she enters Avalon Forest in search of the power to save her mother. A summoned demon becomes trapped inside her stuffed cat, Cheshire. The journey begins with two reluctant companions whose different abilities must work together, presented through illustrated pages and narration that give this earlier chapter the form of a storybook.

cards.heading: One controller holds an uneasy partnership
cards.text: The player controls Cereza and Cheshire together, assigning movement and actions to separate sides of the controller. Cereza can bind enemies with magic, leaving Cheshire to attack them. Away from combat, their cooperation opens routes through the forest. Cheshire can grow into his demon form or shrink into the toy Cereza carries. Switching between those forms changes how the pair cross an obstacle and stay close enough to help each other when the path becomes dangerous.

cards.heading: A storybook opens another path
cards.text: Elemental powers expand Cheshire's abilities and make previously blocked routes accessible. Returning through the forest can therefore reveal something that the companions could see earlier but could not reach. Combat and exploration both develop the same relationship: Cereza needs the demon's strength, while Cheshire depends on her to restore his magic. The painted environments keep the characters small within an uncertain world, allowing the gradual confidence of the young witch to emerge through the actions the player learns to perform with both companions.

main.title: Resident Evil 4
main.summary: Resident Evil 4 is a 2023 survival horror game developed and published by Capcom.

cards.heading: Revisiting the 2005 game
cards.text: Resident Evil 4 is a 2023 survival horror game developed and published by Capcom. A remake of the 2005 game Resident Evil 4, it was released for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S on March 24, 2023. Versions for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS were released on December 20, 2023, and the Gold Edition for Nintendo Switch 2 was released on October 16, 2026.

cards.heading: Leon, Ashley and a reworked rescue
cards.text: Players control the US agent Leon S. Kennedy, who must save Ashley Graham, the daughter of the US president, from a mysterious cult in rural Spain. The remake has an updated plot, new visuals, characters, cast, and modernized gameplay, in line with Biohazard (2017), Village (2021) and other Resident Evil remakes. The team expanded Ashley's characterization and relationship with Leon and used Capcom's RE Engine. Two pieces of downloadable content were released: the minigame Mercenaries, in which players battle waves of enemies, and the side story Separate Ways, in which players control the agent Ada Wong.

cards.heading: Critical recognition and a sales milestone
cards.text: Resident Evil 4 received critical acclaim and was nominated for the Golden Joystick Award for Ultimate Game of the Year and The Game Award for Game of the Year. It had sold over 10 million copies by April 2025, making it the fastest title in the series to reach that milestone at the time. Capcom reported 16 million copies sold as of June 30, 2026.

main.title: Minecraft Legends
main.summary: Minecraft Legends is a 2023 real-time action-strategy video game developed by Mojang Studios and Blackbird Interactive and published by Xbox Game Studios.

cards.heading: Minecraft becomes an action-strategy game
cards.text: Minecraft Legends is a 2023 real-time action-strategy video game developed by Mojang Studios and Blackbird Interactive and published by Xbox Game Studios.

cards.heading: Platforms, release and the end of development
cards.text: A spin-off of the 2011 sandbox game Minecraft, it was released on Windows, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S on April 18, 2023. On January 10, 2024, the developers announced that no further content updates would be released; the game remained playable.

cards.heading: Defending the Overworld
cards.text: The goal of the game is to defend the Overworld from an invasion of piglins, pig-like humanoid creatures from the Nether dimension, while the player gradually strengthens their structures and troops with resources harvested. The game received mixed reviews from critics, with its gameplay being both praised for its execution and criticized for its repetitive nature.

cards.heading: A generated battlefield
cards.text: Minecraft Legends is set in the Minecraft Overworld, an earth-like dimension filled with various biomes and natural resources that is currently under attack from the piglin hordes from the Nether dimension. The Overworld contains friendly villages, hostile piglin outposts, and the Well of Fate (the player spawnpoint and fast-travel hub). Similarly to Minecraft, the Overworld is procedurally generated, resulting in a unique world for each playthrough of the game.

cards.heading: Resources and reinforcements
cards.text: Players collect resources to construct defenses, upgrade buildings, and summon troops. Players collect basic resources such as wood and stone by assigning friendly Allays to harvest them from deposits found in the Overworld. Resources such as redstone require Well of Fate upgrades before they can be gathered and are used for advanced structures and troops. Lapis lazuli, used to summon troops, is obtained by defeating piglins and opening village chests. Prismarine, which is needed to construct some buildings, can only be collected by defeating piglin structures. The player can use resources they've collected to construct buildings and upgrade the Well of Fate. Defensive fortifications such as walls and turrets protect friendly villages and player outposts. Spawners summon friendly troops the players can recruit into their army. Offensive structures such as the redstone cannon hurl explosive shells at targets from long range. Upgrading the Well of Fate unlocks more advanced buildings and troops.

main.title: Dead Island 2
main.subtitle: A zombie outbreak in Los Angeles
main.summary: Dead Island 2 is a 2023 action role-playing survival horror game developed by Dambuster Studios and published by Deep Silver.

cards.heading: A zombie outbreak in Los Angeles
cards.text: Dead Island 2 is a 2023 action role-playing survival horror game developed by Dambuster Studios and published by Deep Silver. It is a sequel to Dead Island (2011) and the third major installment in the series. Set about 15 years after the events of the original game and Dead Island: Riptide (2013), the game follows six playable characters (dubbed Slayers) as they attempt to escape a full quarantine restricted zone in Los Angeles in the midst of a zombie apocalypse. Instead of a large open world like its predecessor, Los Angeles is split into 10 different open zones, which players can freely explore. Players can use a variety of melee weapons, firearms and explosives to dispatch enemies. The game utilized a procedurally generated dismemberment system, used to create weapon-appropriate wounds on zombies.

cards.heading: Slayers, co-op and connected districts
cards.text: Like its predecessor, Dead Island 2 is an action role-playing game played from a first-person perspective. While players can play the game solo, it also supports three-player cooperative multiplayer. Dead Island 2 takes place in Los Angeles in the midst of a zombie apocalypse. At the beginning of the game, players select from one of six playable characters as their player avatar, called a Slayer, each with their own unique skills and abilities. They have to choose from one of two defensive abilities, either learning to block or dodge hostile attacks; a well-timed dodge or block can open up opportunities for counterattack. The game's world is divided into 10 different zones. While the player can freely explore each zone, they must travel between different zones through Zone Exits. As the player progresses in the game, they will unlock fast travel points, allowing them to travel to different locations quickly. Each location also has their own side quests and unique zombie types.

cards.heading: Weapons, modifications and the workbench
cards.text: Weapons favour different targets: headhunting weapons reward blows to the head, while maiming weapons tear away limbs. Force affects an enemy's Stability, and Speed determines how quickly attacks follow one another. Mods add elemental effects, which can interact with the environment; an electric weapon thrown into a puddle can shock the enemies standing in it. The FLESH system produces wounds suited to the weapon used. Equipment degrades during combat, making workbenches useful stops for repairs, upgrades and crafting. Two equipped Curveballs provide throwable attacks with a cooldown between uses.

main.title: Advance Wars 1+2: Re-Boot Camp
main.subtitle: Two classic campaigns return
main.summary: Advance Wars 1+2: Re-Boot Camp is a 2023 turn-based strategy video game developed by WayForward and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo Switch.

cards.heading: Two classic campaigns return
cards.text: Advance Wars 1+2: Re-Boot Camp is a 2023 turn-based strategy video game developed by WayForward and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo Switch. It is a remake of the first two titles in the Advance Wars series, Advance Wars (2001), and Advance Wars 2: Black Hole Rising (2003), both developed by Intelligent Systems. The game includes both campaigns and a Versus mode for two to four players locally, while online matches support two players. In both games, players control a variety of land, air, and sea-based units, each with their own strengths and weaknesses that need to be accounted for. They also take the role of various Commanding Officers who similarly have their own strengths and weaknesses with respect to both units and terrain.

cards.heading: Delays and the eventual return
cards.text: Re-Boot Camp was originally slated for a December 2021 release, but it was delayed to April 2022, only to be delayed indefinitely in March 2022 due to the Russian invasion of Ukraine. The game was eventually released on April 21, 2023 and received generally positive reviews from critics.

main.title: Cassette Beasts
main.subtitle: An RPG arrives on PC, consoles and mobile
main.summary: Cassette Beasts is a role-playing video game developed by Bytten Studio and published by Raw Fury.

cards.heading: An RPG arrives on PC, consoles and mobile
cards.text: Cassette Beasts is a role-playing video game developed by Bytten Studio and published by Raw Fury. It was released for the PC on April 26, 2023, and was released for the Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch on May 25, 2023. It was released simultaneously on Xbox Game Pass as the day of its PC release date. It was released for Android and iOS on January 15, 2025.

cards.heading: Cassette transformations and a journey home
cards.text: The game is inspired by the Pokémon video game series and follows the progress of the player as they transform into monsters using a cassette player while trying to return home. Cassette Beasts received generally favorable reviews from critics, who commented positively on its complexity. The game was nominated for a 2024 BAFTA Games Award, but lost.

cards.heading: Cassette Beasts 2002 is announced
cards.text: In June 2026, it was announced that a sequel Cassette Beasts 2002 is currently in development and will be released on the PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, Switch 2, and PC.
